findings: Dimensionless metrics shown as percentages — confirmed: unit 1 is treated as a 0–1 ratio, so load averages are multiplied by 100 and labeled %. Add metric display semantics or format only known ratios as percentages.

No-data summaries marked Healthy — confirmed: Overview and Setup show 0 / 0 as Healthy, and Containers shows Healthy when limits or restart counts are entirely absent. Return NO_DATA until the relevant denominator or measurement exists.
Conflicting container-memory thresholds — confirmed: the fleet warns at 80% while Container 360 reports no near-limit finding below 90%. Use one product threshold or keep the 80% count neutral.

Alert prefill locks the Rules subview — confirmed: persistent router state outranks URL tab changes, so the other Alerts views cannot be opened after a metric prefill. Consume and clear the one-time prefill state.
Disk lane opens no section — confirmed: Host 360 targets #disk, but its storage section is #storage; the page falls back to Overview. Map the Disk lane to Storage.

Log cursor drops tied rows — confirmed: pagination omits tenant and instance from its cursor despite using them in merged row identity. Use the same unique ordering tuple in SQL, merge sorting, and cursor encoding.

Truncated container first-seen time — confirmed: the backend searches only 24 hours before the selected range but labels the earliest sample as absolute first seen. Query retained history or qualify the label and range.
